mainEntity.name: What is AI by MMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is MMC's set of AI-powered services: AI photoshoot, AI video generation, AI sales agent, AI UGC, AI landing page builder and AI spokesperson video. Each is run by our team and connected to performance marketing.

mainEntity.name: Who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: D2C brands, B2B companies and colleges and education brands.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to use all six?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Start with the one that removes your biggest bottleneck. Many teams begin with images or landing pages.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from an AI tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tool gives you software. We give you finished work, reviewed by people, and we measure it in your ad account.

mainEntity.name: What does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope, so we quote after a short call.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: One clear, high-resolution photo of the product, person or place, plus a list of the scenes you want.

mainEntity.name: Will the product still look like our product?

acceptedAnswer.text: We start from your real photo and check every scene against it. Anything that drifts from the real product is corrected or dropped before you see it.

mainEntity.name: Can we use the images in paid ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We format the files for ad platforms, marketplaces and your website. Check each platform's current rules on AI-generated imagery, and we will flag anything relevant.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the number of scenes and the rounds of changes. We confirm the timing when we scope the work.

mainEntity.name: Do you also run the ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can. AI by MMC sits next to our performance marketing, so images can go straight into testing and reporting.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of video can AI make for us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product films, ad hooks, explainers, mascot animations and stylised brand stories. Live footage of real people is a different job and we will tell you when a real shoot is the better fit.

mainEntity.name: Do you use our real product?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build from your product images and check every shot against them.

mainEntity.name: Can videos be made in different languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voice-over and captions can be produced in the languages your audience uses. We confirm the language list when we scope the work.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ownership and usage terms are agreed in the project scope.

mainEntity.name: Can you run the ads too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Video sits inside our performance loop, so hooks are tested and reported on.

mainEntity.name: What can the agent do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer questions from the material you approve, ask qualifying questions, share links and book calls. It hands over to a person when a conversation needs one.

mainEntity.name: Where does it run?

acceptedAnswer.text: On your website and on WhatsApp. Other channels can be scoped.

mainEntity.name: Will it make things up?

acceptedAnswer.text: It answers from the content you approve. Where it does not know, it says so and hands over.

mainEntity.name: Does it connect to our CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We connect it to the tools you already use and confirm the list when we scope the work.

mainEntity.name: Who sets it up?

acceptedAnswer.text: MMC does, and we keep improving it from the conversations it has.

mainEntity.name: Is this real people or AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The presenters and voices are AI-generated. We label content as the platforms and the law require and we will advise on disclosure.

mainEntity.name: Can we use our own spokesperson?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is a separate service, AI Spokesperson Video, and it is built from a real person's approved footage.

mainEntity.name: Which languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hinglish, English and a range of regional languages. We confirm your list when we scope the work.

mainEntity.name: Can we run these as paid ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build them for ad accounts and check each platform's current rules.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us?

acceptedAnswer.text: The product or course, a few claims you can stand behind, and access to the ad account if you want us to launch.
